record.issue_text: app-credential.ts: no try/catch around the decrypt/JSON.parse of keys, so malformed ciphertext with the webhook secret can trigger 500s

adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler decrypts and parses `keys` via `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no try/catch. If `symmetricDecrypt` throws (bad ciphertext/wrong key) or `JSON.parse` throws (non-JSON plaintext), the exception will bubble and Next.js will return a 500. Since the webhook secret check happens before this, any caller who knows the webhook secret (or any internal misconfiguration) can trigger these 500s with malformed `keys`.
